description: Get Keyword Planner search-volume history for supplied keywords. Returns average monthly searches, monthly volumes (up to 48 months), latest volume, computed 3-month and YoY changes, competition, CPC/bid ranges, close variants, and optional device totals. This is a read-only planless RPC.

customerId.description: Google Ads serving customer ID; use the client account, not its MCC manager

endYearMonth.description: Optional inclusive historical range end YYYY-MM

geoTargetIds.description: Geo target criterion IDs, e.g. 2250 for France; empty means all geographies

historyMonths.description: History length when no explicit YYYY-MM range is supplied; 24 enables YoY calculation

includeAdultKeywords.description: Allow adult keyword ideas where supported by the provider and the selected market.

includeAverageCpc.description: Request legacy average CPC in addition to top-of-page bid ranges

includeDeviceBreakdown.description: Return aggregate searches by device across all requested keywords

includeMonthlySearchVolumes.description: Include every monthly point in the MCP output. Set false to trim an allowed response; Google's upstream series and the 50,000-point guard are unchanged

keywords.description: Keywords to analyze; Google may combine near-exact close variants

languageId.description: Optional language criterion ID, e.g. 1002 for French; omit for all languages

network.description: Google Ads search network selector used for planning.

startYearMonth.description: Optional inclusive historical range start YYYY-MM

name: google_ads_generate_keyword_historical_metrics

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads generate keyword historical metrics
